275785833.description:
Hayim Pinhas
Hand-Carved Meerschaum Pipe
Product of Turkey, Pure Block Meerschaum
A genuine block meerschaum tobacco pipe handcrafted by Hayim Pinhas in Istanbul, Turkey. Meerschaum is a rare, porous mineral found in Asia Minor, highly valued by collectors for its ability to provide a cool, dry smoke while gradually absorbing oils to develop a rich, honey-colored patina over time. This piece represents traditional Turkish craftsmanship in tobacco accessories.
Hand-carved bowl featuring an intricate floral and lattice pattern
Classic straight stem in a deep maroon finish with metal mountings
Includes original red presentation box and informational documentation from the maker
Crafted from high-quality pure block meerschaum as noted in original papers
Condition:
The pipe is in excellent condition with no visible charring or heavy use. A handwritten inventory number "136" is present inside the bowl rim. The stem is intact with no visible teeth marks or cracking. The original red box shows significant external wear, including a large surface tear on the lid and rubbing along the edges. The included documentation is legible with standard folding creases.

276012624.description:
Title:
Natural Chrysanthemum Black Mineral Specimen Collectible
Category:
Collectibles & Art
Country Of Origin:
Morocco
Description:
Discover natural history with this striking Orthoceras fossil stone featuring a unique starburst pattern. Crafted by the earth over millions of years, this remarkable specimen showcases a radiating, creamy fossil embedded in a deep black limestone matrix. Its dramatic contrast makes it a prime display piece for collectors and enthusiasts alike. This Orthoceras fossil fragment is believed to originate from Morocco, a renowned source of these ancient marine fossils. The starburst orthoceras imprint stands out beautifully against the dark stone, offering both scientific intrigue and visual appeal. Perfect for display on shelves, desks, or curio cabinets, it makes a fascinating conversation starter and educational gift for those interested in geology or prehistoric life. Rest assured, this stone is naturally formed and selected for its standout fossil structure and aesthetics. Add a distinctive, museum-quality piece to your collection and enjoy lasting beauty that connects you to Earth's distant past.
